title: Waxpol 10W 30 4T Petrol Scooter Engine Oil 800ml + Chain Lubricant Spray 150ml
description: 4T Gearless Scooter Oil- Get a more responsive engine with an improved stop-go performance and change oil quickly with easy use Telescopic Spout Bottle. Our lubrication technology reduces friction and ensures stay-in-grade performance by minimizing oxidative thickening, resulting in lower fuel consumption and improved engine responsiveness. This engine oil increases the engine's lifespan by safeguarding it against sludge formation, friction, wear, and corrosion. Chain Lube is FULLY SYNTHETIC CHAIN LUBRICANT, Specially Formulated for very fast moving motorcycles. For use on Standard, O-Ring, X-Ring and Z-Ring, Street Motorcycles, Go-Karts etc. Designed for all chain care needs internal and external. REDUCES FRICTION/ Wear and Tear. Thus increase chain life & performance. Maximizes power transfer to give excellent performance. Doesn't throw off in high speed. GIVES Superior PROTECTION from Corrosion, Anti wear as well as Water Wash Resistant. 4T Gearless Scooter Oil has Exceptional Thermal & Shear Stability - Our engine oil delivers superior stay-in-grade performance in all climates and seasons. It reduces oxidation, viscosity loss, oil consumption, and emissions, providing an extended drain interval, ensuring the engine's longevity. Keep Clean Technology - With maximum soot dispersion, our engine oil protects against sludge formation, even in stop-go traffic conditions. Chain Lube PENETRATES deep into pins and bushings of chain. Extremely easy to use with spray nozzle and easy clean-up. It forms a very thin film when applied for easy penetration and coverage. Then it thickens and increases tack (becomes sticky) to give long lasting lubrication that does not drip. This is a neutral high performance Chain Lubricant
